authored_by: the team, labelling its own synthetic data
source_of_truth: 02_src/adii/examples/canonical_world.py: the world was generated knowing what happened in it; a development key, never an unseen one
freeze_note: Frozen on authoring, 23 Sep 2026, before any run against it. A replacement for the burned load-stopped cases, written under the REPAIR validity rule in final_plan.md. A correction is a new key, never an edit. Version 2 of revenue-drop-5eb8d3, 23 Sep 2026 (decision A2): the same world and the same answer; only the alert changed, to name the orders it measured.
purpose: The development set's label for this generated incident.
root_cause_explanation: Every order for 2026-10-14 arrived and loaded (120 in raw_orders; load_log SUCCESS, 120 loaded; the vendor receipt and the manifest agree). That morning's change to the staging transform, DATA-97, meant to leave sandbox test orders out, names Quill — live distributors with two weeks of normal orders — from 2026-10-14, so their 42 orders never reached the mart. Distributor agreements are unchanged. The release that morning is unrelated.

repair_must_satisfy.description: Stage every delivered order exactly once again, so the mart counts all of the day's orders; change nothing else.
repair_must_satisfy.reference_patch_effect: stg_orders as it was before DATA-97: staged up to the loader's acknowledged line, with no distributor left out
alternative_repairs_are_acceptable_if: every order in raw_orders appears in stg_orders exactly once
daily revenue equals the delivered orders' amounts, day by day
no amount is scaled, estimated or copied from another day
repair_must_satisfy.validation_requirement: REPAIR is only correct if the validator accepts it.

why_not_no_repair: The mart is wrong relative to its own source: orders that arrived and loaded are missing from it, left out by a staging clause aimed at test orders.
why_not_escalate: The cause is in the permitted transform itself, every decisive fact is reachable, and the repair can be made within the permitted path and checked.
